description.en: Official runtime and operator docs; stable v0.16.1 adds beta-board IMU, NFC, camera and LED support, battery display and sit-on-gamepad-dropout behavior.
description.zh: 官方运行时与操作文档；稳定版 v0.16.1 增加 beta 板 IMU、NFC、摄像头与 LED 支持、电池显示，以及手柄断连后坐下的行为。

description.en: Official CUDA training workspace with v7 lineage and Hub publishing; bundled STL meshes are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 while the remaining files stay Apache-2.0.
description.zh: 官方 CUDA 训练工程，含 v7 训练谱系与 Hub 发布流程；内含 STL 网格采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，其余文件保持 Apache-2.0。

description.en: Try the hosted simulator before choosing a local setup.
description.zh: 先在线体验仿真，再决定是否搭建本地环境。

description.en: Official v7 ONNX set; authors report real-robot validation for safer seated head moves and standing roll/pitch control, while crouch remains unlearned.
description.zh: 官方 v7 ONNX 策略集；作者报告已在真机验证坐姿头部动作稳定性与站立横滚/俯仰控制，但下蹲仍未学会。

description.en: Find the relevant operator or developer guide.
description.zh: 按操作与开发需求查找上游文档。

description.en: Run the real runtime daemons against MuJoCo bodies; physical buses and device drivers remain outside the simulation.
description.zh: 用真实运行时守护进程驱动 MuJoCo 机体；物理总线和设备驱动不在仿真范围内。

description.en: Track stable daemon releases separately from signed development builds.
description.zh: 跟踪稳定版 daemon，并与签名开发构建区分。

description.en: Community guide spanning simulation, training and DIY research; keep its source labels and unresolved hardware questions in view.
description.zh: 覆盖仿真、训练与复刻研究的双语社区指南；阅读时保留对来源标签和未决硬件问题的关注。

description.en: Look up commands for the installed runtime version.
description.zh: 查阅对应运行时版本的操作命令。

description.en: Check policy metadata and compatibility requirements.
description.zh: 核对策略元数据与兼容性要求。

description.en: Apple Silicon and CPU training lab with browser worlds, multi-duck soccer and tidying behaviors; all reviewed results remain simulation-only.
description.zh: 面向 Apple Silicon 与 CPU 的训练实验室，含浏览器世界、多鸭足球和整理行为；本次核验结果仍仅限仿真。

description.en: Explore a portable PyTorch implementation; check backend limitations first.
description.zh: 探索 PyTorch 移植方案；先阅读各计算后端的限制。

description.en: An AMD-oriented training alternative; follow its tested configuration.
description.zh: 面向 AMD 的训练替代方案；使用项目列出的已测试配置。

description.en: Task-port research. The reviewed README reports unsuccessful locomotion; do not select it as a ready walking policy.
description.zh: 任务移植研究。核验时 README 明示行走尚未成功，不应作为现成行走策略。

description.en: ROS 2 Jazzy viewer and Isaac Sim/Lab tutorials now pin the official v7 policies; the converted USD and GPU playback still await revalidation, and there is no physical driver.
description.zh: ROS 2 Jazzy 查看器与 Isaac Sim/Lab 教程现已固定官方 v7 策略；转换后的 USD 与 GPU 回放仍待复验，且不含真机驱动。

description.en: Community MuJoCo and ONNX simulator with touch controls and policy import; it does not control physical hardware.
description.zh: 支持触控与策略导入的社区 MuJoCo 和 ONNX 仿真器；不控制实体硬件。

description.en: Reproducible simulations cover chimney climbing, a raised-platform long jump and a backflip with published policies; hardware remains untested and the backflip carries a breakage warning.
description.zh: 可复现仿真涵盖烟囱攀爬、高台长跳与后空翻并发布策略；真机仍未测试，后空翻明确提示可能损坏机器人。

description.en: Zero-dependency Swift implementation of the policy, observation, kinematics and RPC contracts; author reports 347 offline tests but no hardware validation.
description.zh: 以零依赖 Swift 实现策略、观测、运动学与 RPC 契约；作者报告 347 项离线测试，但尚无真机验证。

description.en: A development interface joining runtime and simulation; requires sibling repositories.
description.zh: 连接运行时与仿真的开发界面；需配套同级仓库。

description.en: Agent interface with mock and simulation paths. Its README states real-device transports have only fake-daemon validation.
description.zh: 提供 mock 与仿真路径的 Agent 接口；README 说明真机传输仅经过伪守护进程验证。

description.en: Goal-directed robot CLI and MCP bridge with Microduck mock and MuJoCo paths; its JSON-RPC hardware backend has only pinned-name fake validation.
description.zh: 面向目标任务的机器人 CLI 与 MCP 桥接，支持 Microduck mock 和 MuJoCo；其 JSON-RPC 真机后端仅做过固定上游名称的伪实现验证。

description.en: Chinese assembly and setup guide with author-published hardware clips; its configuration differs from the official product.
description.zh: 中文装机与部署教程，作者提供实物视频；配置与官方产品不同。

description.en: Parametric external-compute mount with printable CAD and reproducible payload-policy studies; fit, strength and control results remain simulation-only.
description.zh: 面向外置算力的参数化挂载方案，提供可打印 CAD 与可复现的载荷策略研究；适配、强度和控制结果仍仅限仿真。

description.en: The HD-1910 build now reports a BNO085, 15-servo control loop, HOME and a 10-second policy hold on hardware; continuous walking remains unverified after thermal throttling.
description.zh: HD-1910 复刻现已在真机跑通 BNO085、15 舵机控制环、HOME 与 10 秒策略保持；因过热降频，连续行走仍未验证。

description.en: Arduino Uno Q adaptation with author hardware demos; pre-2026-10-02 boards require a documented U3, U4 and U5 GND/signal wiring check before power-up.
description.zh: 基于 Arduino Uno Q 且有作者实机演示；2026-10-02 前生产的板卡上电前需按文档核对 U3、U4、U5 的 GND/信号线。

description.en: Completed community replica with author-published hardware footage and packaged BOM, print and board files; review the non-commercial model terms.
description.zh: 已完成的社区复刻，提供作者实机演示、BOM、打印与板件资料；使用前核对模型的非商业条款。
